title: The Gold-Masked One - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: The Gold-Masked One in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: The Gold-Masked One phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Gold-Masked One is a recurring optional encounter in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley, found at Lóng Pillar trials, five times.

sections.title: Where to Find the The Gold-Masked One
sections.content:
Location: Lóng Pillar trials, five times.

Appears in: Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It recurs, so the second meeting is fought with whatever the first one taught.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: No drop is recorded for this encounter in the sources checked, so none is listed. That is a gap in the record rather than a statement that it drops nothing.

sections.title: How to Beat the The Gold-Masked One
sections.content:
What works

  • A recurring optional challenger tied to the Long Pillar trials - you meet him five times.
  • He escalates each meeting; do not assume the pattern from the previous fight still holds.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 7 of 60 in the progression order, in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley. Before it: Aberrant Three-Faced Puppet. After it: Puppet Scavenger. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
